body:
## Summary
- Add a persisted album option that creates a dependent `full album` pipeline stage immediately after the source album stage.
- Keep album tracks as individual release uploads, while the derived full-album stage renders all album tracks sequentially into one video.
- Give the derived stage its own title, description, timing interval, YouTube metadata, disabled Album type selector, and generated timestamp block based on source track order and durations.
- Allow the source album checkbox to remove the dependent full-album stage again.
- Highlight the derived full-album stage with a thick solid gold border.
- Avoid whole-stage rerenders while typing date/time and interval values so native pickers do not close after one edit.
- Preserve issue and PR investigation artifacts in `docs/case-studies/issue-179`.
- Preserve migration from the previous checkbox-only implementation into the dependent stage model.
- Add Cypress coverage for derived-stage creation, removal, custom interval persistence, generated timestamps, upload title/description, and task count behavior.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#179

## Tests
- `npm run typecheck` passed.
- `npm test -- --runInBand` passed: 342 tests.
- `npm run test:e2e -- --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js`: full-album regression passed; suite result was 24 passing / 2 failing due to existing unrelated failures at `cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js:256` and `cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js:396`.
